```ts
function injectKeyLockState(key): Signal<boolean | null>;
```

Defined in: [injectKeyLockState.ts:39](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/angular-hotkeys/src/injectKeyLockState.ts#L39)

Angular inject-based API that returns a signal of whether a lock key, such
as Caps Lock, is on.

Lock keys toggle instead of being held, so this reads the lock state that
the browser reports on key and mouse events. The signal is `null` until the
user presses a key, clicks, or moves the mouse, after the window loses
focus or the page is hidden, and always for Num Lock and Scroll Lock on macOS and iOS.

## Parameters

### key

`MaybeGetter`\<`LockKey`\>

`'CapsLock'`, `'NumLock'`, or `'ScrollLock'` - can be a getter function

## Returns

`Signal`\<`boolean` \| `null`\>

Signal that is `true` when the lock is on, `false` when it is off, or `null`

## Example

```ts
@Component({
  template: `
    <label>
      Password
      <input type="password" />
      @if (capsLock()) {
        <span role="status">Caps Lock is on</span>
      }
    </label>
  `,
})
export class PasswordFieldComponent {
  capsLock = injectKeyLockState('CapsLock')
}
```
